headline_outcome: Secure Your Warehouse Before It's Up
primary_text: "Our lease is up in 12 months and the landlord wants a 30% increase or we're out." If your lease expires in 12 months, you need to act now — not in 6 months when you're desperate. Off-the-plan warehouses in Truganina are being snapped up by business owners in exactly your position. Lock in your new space today and plan your move on your terms. 20km from Melbourne CBD with Princes Freeway and West Gate Tunnel access. Don't wait until you're out of options. The time to secure your warehouse is now.
description: Lock in your new warehouse now and move on your timeline, not your landlord's
